title: Big Rusty and Gogodze Phu drum kits (referenced)
description: Manifest, source list and recipes are CC0-1.0; the referenced drum samples are CC0 1.0 (see LICENSE.md). Big Rusty Drums (kick, snare, closed hat, tom, ride) and Gogodze Phu Vol II (kick, snare, closed and open hat, three toms), one close-mic velocity layer with round robins, referenced at pinned commits; no audio in this repo.
